Name: Seasons of the world
Author: ChincerDante
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod brings all the seasons to your doorstep! base on my other mod this farm uses "fourseasonlandscaping" mod from justchaldea to lock each unique area into a specific zone and set the different bodies of water to catch different fish creating a unique aesthetic that persist no matter the year the grass is Tilable.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod requires Content Patcher and FourSeasonsTotalLandscaping to function, please make sure to install both from their respective mod pages.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The folder provided must be placed in mods just like the rest of the Smapi enabled mods.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8](optional) FourseasonsTotalLandscaping comes by default with pierre's missing stock enable(all seeds available all year round), i find this to be too fast of an unlock for my taste, it is personal preference to change the mentioned mod config file if you wish to start with just the regular seeds[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]A large map where you can plant your crops ignoring the calendar year, focusing instead of layout and space, each zone is lock to a different season , the winter peaks, the spring meadows, the autumn forest and the summer beach.[/color][/size][/*]
[*]grandpa built his house on the goldilocks zone, any crop will grow here regardless of season, and the circular shape is ideal for some decor ideas.[/*]
[*]Fish is location specific around the farm, with the winter having mountain fish, Forest fish for the meadows and Forest, and Ocean fish for the beach[/*]
[*]Forageables spawn occasionally around[/*]
[*]berry bushes exist around for the berry seasons.[/*]
[*]Tillable Grass! it is nearly all decoration only, you can tile in most spaces of the map.[/*]
[/list](optional) a more vanilla version of this map exist, for those that like the layout but find the season and area gimmick to be too unbalanced, check "Corners of the world" mod

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod requires "FourSeasonsTotalLandscaping" mod to function on top of Content patcher.[/color][/size]
